* Should you repeat this, your results will almost certainly differ from mine. * Finally, and I'm only bringing this up to cover all my bases, the actual game will likely differ from the prediction.

Denver Averaged 76.8 yards passing with 1.4 interceptions, and 58 yards rushing.

Carolina Averaged 140.2 yards passing, also with 1.4 interceptions, and 64 yards rushing.

Denver Scored, on average, 14.6 points, with no mode, since there were no repeating values, a range of 12, and a median of 13.

Carolina won in 3 of the 5 simulations, giving a winning probability of 3/5, or 0.6, or 60%
